name: Drowners of Fate

tenures.role: tag team — billed for ICW: The Last Call
tenures.source: the show forum's own topic list, which carries the booked match “Drowners of fate Vs. Austin/Elite”, opened by the show's own booker and four replies deep (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-icw-the-last-call-130.html)
tenures.note: Neither man is named. The team is booked by its team name alone and appears nowhere else in the record; the twenty-name scheduled-superstars list for the same show does not carry it.

caption: A tag team booked against “Stone Cold” Steve Austin and The Elite on the farewell card, named only as a team and never as two men.
